scope: Bounded primary-source review and real-browser diagnostics. No production change, proxy, native installation, hidden-video implementation, authentication bypass, or claim of physical screen-off playback.

youtube.findingLimit: No documented third-party embedded audio-only/background mode was found in the reviewed official API documentation. This is not a claim that every possible browser behavior was tested.
youtube.premium: Current benefits documentation describes background playback in signed-in YouTube mobile applications. The former mobile-browser background-help article redirects to that benefits page. Neither establishes an embedded-player background entitlement for Pletina.

pwaApis.mediaSession: Metadata and media-control integration; does not provide a stream URL or convert a remote provider player into a background audio service.
pwaApis.serviceWorker: Event-driven worker. Its lifetime is not tied to references held by a page; a browser may terminate it when idle or when tasks exceed limits.
pwaApis.backgroundFetch: Visible browser-managed resource downloads, not playback. Cross-origin resources must permit CORS. It does not create access to unavailable media or guarantee iPhone implementation.
